title: AIExecutionRequest
description: Provider-neutral AI capability request from a Specialist OS to Local AI Control Center. Expresses capability intent, NOT provider implementation. NO reasoning_content, NO chain-of-thought, NO raw provider secrets.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for this AI execution request.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID linking to the business/delivery flow.

idempotencyKey.description: Ensures duplicate requests do not trigger duplicate AI execution.

inputRef.description: Reference to the input data (URI or system-internal reference).

payload.description: Inline payload when input is small enough for direct inclusion.

dataSensitivity.description: Data sensitivity classification for the request.

modelPreference.description: Optional model preference (advisory only; Local AI Control Center may override).

identityClaimsRef.description: Reference to the IdentityClaims for this request.

entitlementDecisionRef.description: Reference to the EntitlementDecision authorizing this request.

credentialRefs.description: Credential references needed for AI provider access (references only, NO raw keys).
